commentary.text: 90+7' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+6' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Raul Moro (Valladolid) takes it short.
90+4' 1 - 2 Goal! Mario Maroto pulls the ball back for Ivan Sanchez (Valladolid) on the edge of the box, and he beats the keeper with a fine strike inside the left post. 1:2.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Valladolid can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
88' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Valladolid.
88' Raul Chasco Ruiz (Valladolid) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Valladolid.
86' The attendance is 20338.
86' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Antonio Sanchez (Mallorca) will replace Robert Navarro.
85' Eray Comert (Valladolid) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
83' 0 - 2 Goal! Valery (Mallorca) pounced on a loose ball inside the penalty area and beats the goalkeeper with a shot into the bottom right corner. He makes it 0:2.
81' The foul by Juanmi Latasa (Valladolid) was seen by Jose Luis Munuera Montero who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
81' 0:4 - the latest stats for both teams in respect of shots on target.
76' Abdulay Juma Bah (Valladolid) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
76' The referee allows time for a substitution. Sergi Darder will be replaced by Valery (Mallorca).
76' Jagoba Arrasate has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Chiquinho (Mallorca) replacing Daniel Rodriguez.
75' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Cyle Larin trots off the pitch and is replaced by Abdon Prats (Mallorca).
74' Sergi Darder (Mallorca) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.

74' Sergi Darder (Mallorca) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Mallorca.
72' That will be all from David Torres who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Mario Maroto (Valladolid).
70' Valladolid failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
68' Samu Costa (Mallorca) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
67' The resulting set piece from Valladolid is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
65' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Mamadou Sylla (Valladolid) comes onto the pitch so that Mario Martin can be given a rest.
65' Paulo Pezzolano has decided to make a change. Stanko Juric (Valladolid) replaces Kike Perez.
65' Substitution. Omar Mascarell (Mallorca) replaces Manu Morlanes.
64' Juanmi Latasa (Valladolid) rises high to head a nice lofted cross towards the middle of the goal. Unfortunately for him, his close-range effort lacks pace and Leo Roman makes a comfortable save.
59' 0 - 1 It's in the back of the net! Daniel Rodriguez plays it into the box, and Cyle Larin (Mallorca) gets on the end of the cross to put it inside the left post. 0:1.
58' Jose Luis Munuera Montero blows his whistle as Kike Perez (Valladolid) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
55' A cross from Sergi Darder (Mallorca) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
54' A short pass finds Manu Morlanes (Mallorca). He spots the keeper off his line and shoots from mid-range, but the ball sails high over the bar.
52' Valladolid have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
51' Substitution. Luis Perez is replaced by Raul Chasco Ruiz (Valladolid).
51' Here is a change. Darwin Machis is going off and Paulo Pezzolano gives the last tactical orders to Ivan Sanchez (Valladolid).
48' Mallorca take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
47' Pablo Maffeo provides the assist in the box, but Cyle Larin (Mallorca) places his shot a fraction wide of the right post.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+2' Jose Luis Munuera Montero has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+2' Lucas Rosa (Valladolid) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows for a foul after seeing the whole situation.
45' We will have 1 min. of added time.
43' Jose Copete (Mallorca) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Jose Luis Munuera Montero has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
42' Johan Mojica (Mallorca) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.

41' Karl Hein makes a brilliant save! Robert Navarro (Mallorca) easily weaves through the defence and unleashes a shot from just outside of the box. His low shot goes towards the middle of the goal but is saved by keeper!
40' Juanmi Latasa (Valladolid) was standing in a clear offside position, making it an easy call for the linesman.
39' The corner is swung into the six-yard box and Antonio Raillo (Mallorca) gets his head on the ball, but he is unable to keep it down and it goes miles over the bar.
38' The referee signals a corner kick to Mallorca.
38' Cyle Larin (Mallorca) controls a cross inside the box and sends a shot towards the left post, but one of the defenders reacts superbly to block his effort. Mallorca win a corner.
35' Kike Perez (Valladolid) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
31' Darwin Machis (Valladolid) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and has an effort on goal. Unfortunately for him, his strike flies inches high over the bar.
28' A cross from a corner kick by Valladolid is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
26' Manu Morlanes (Mallorca) has tested the patience of referee Jose Luis Munuera Montero and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
25' A quickly taken corner by Mallorca.

24' Samu Costa (Mallorca) fashions a shot from the edge of the box after receiving an accurate pass. Karl Hein makes a stunning save to stop the effort from flying into the left side of the goal. Now Mallorca have a corner.
22' Sergi Darder (Mallorca) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender.
21' Kike Perez (Valladolid) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
21' Luis Perez (Valladolid) produces a lovely chip pass into the box, but one of the opposition players cuts it out.
19' Juanmi Latasa (Valladolid) receives a decent pass inside the box and curls in an effort on goal, but the ball hits the outside of the left post and flies out of play.
18' Luis Perez (Valladolid) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.

18' That was a poorly executed free kick from long distance. Antonio Raillo (Mallorca) was trying to produce a cross into the penalty area, but his effort sailed off the pitch. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Valladolid.

15' Mallorca slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
10' What a wasted chance that is! A precise cross into the box finds Cyle Larin (Mallorca), whose header flies way wide of the left post.
5' Luis Perez (Valladolid) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
4' Cyle Larin (Mallorca) finds himself behind the opposition's defence, but the game is stopped for offside.
3' Valladolid are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are on the pitch and Mallorca will have the kick-off.
